$description: SongNodes tokens, W3C DTCG. GENERATED from tokens.json by build_agentconf.py. Modes in $extensions.com.songnodes.modes; $value is the dark theme.

bg.$description: Page background (Elektronauts charcoal in dark). Everything sits on it.

surface-1.$description: Panels, neutral cards, table body, drawer, dialog.

surface-2.$description: Raised parts inside a surface-1 panel: table header, hovered row, segmented-control track.

surface-3.$description: Pressed/selected neutral fills, progress tracks, skeleton shimmer base.

sunk.$description: Inputs, code wells, the transition strip between set rows.

line.$description: Dividers and hairlines between rows and sections. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

line-strong.$description: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, chips, checkboxes). Holds 3:1 on bg, surface-1 and surface-2.

fg.$description: Primary text and icons on bg, surface-1, surface-2 and surface-3.

fg-2.$description: Secondary text: metadata lines, table cells that support the main column. 4.5:1 on bg, surface-1, surface-2.

fg-3.$description: Tertiary text: the dimmed lead-in of a thin–bold title, captions, column headers. 4.5:1 on bg and surface-1.

fg-disabled.$description: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast). Pair with not-allowed cursor and aria-disabled.

brand.$description: SongNodes itself: wordmark, the one primary button per view, focus ring, selection outline, the generic link colour where no module applies. Never a status.

brand-strong.$description: Hover and pressed state of brand fills and brand text.

brand-soft.$description: Selected row / selected chip background, current item in the drawer.

on-brand.$description: Text and icons on a brand fill (primary button).

link.$description: Generic text link colour where a link leads nowhere module-specific (help, external sites). Dark uses brand-strong so it holds 4.5:1 on surface-1 and surface-2. Always underlined.

focus.$description: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. Brand lavender holds 3:1 on every surface in every theme.

hover-bg.$description: Hover wash on rows, menu items and quiet buttons.

flag-bg.$description: Background for a row or cell flagged for attention (needs an energy check, duplicate, stale). The only tint used for flagging; pair with a warn marker.

mod-graph.$description: Graph identity: its menu icon, any text link leading to Graph, chart marks that mean 'Graph'. Explore the track graph: nodes, edges, neighbourhoods. Reads 4.5:1 on bg and surface-1.

mod-graph-bg.$description: Tonal card fill for Graph cards and the Graph page header band.

mod-graph-raised.$description: Chips, inner wells and secondary buttons inside a Graph tonal card.

mod-graph-line.$description: Border of a Graph tonal card and dividers inside it.

mod-graph-ink.$description: Titles and primary text inside a Graph tonal card (on mod-graph-bg and mod-graph-raised).

mod-graph-muted.$description: Secondary text inside a Graph tonal card.

on-mod-graph.$description: Text on a solid Graph fill (a Graph action button inside its own page, the module chip in the drawer).

mod-library.$description: Library identity: its menu icon, any text link leading to Library, chart marks that mean 'Library'. The crate: every track, filters, rotation, sources. Reads 4.5:1 on bg and surface-1.

mod-library-bg.$description: Tonal card fill for Library cards and the Library page header band.

mod-library-raised.$description: Chips, inner wells and secondary buttons inside a Library tonal card.

mod-library-line.$description: Border of a Library tonal card and dividers inside it.

mod-library-ink.$description: Titles and primary text inside a Library tonal card (on mod-library-bg and mod-library-raised).

mod-library-muted.$description: Secondary text inside a Library tonal card.

on-mod-library.$description: Text on a solid Library fill (a Library action button inside its own page, the module chip in the drawer).

mod-sets.$description: Set builder identity: its menu icon, any text link leading to Set builder, chart marks that mean 'Set builder'. Sets and setlists: running order, energy wave, saved sets. Reads 4.5:1 on bg and surface-1.

mod-sets-bg.$description: Tonal card fill for Set builder cards and the Set builder page header band.

mod-sets-raised.$description: Chips, inner wells and secondary buttons inside a Set builder tonal card.

mod-sets-line.$description: Border of a Set builder tonal card and dividers inside it.

mod-sets-ink.$description: Titles and primary text inside a Set builder tonal card (on mod-sets-bg and mod-sets-raised).

mod-sets-muted.$description: Secondary text inside a Set builder tonal card.

on-mod-sets.$description: Text on a solid Set builder fill (a Set builder action button inside its own page, the module chip in the drawer).

mod-paths.$description: Pathfinder identity: its menu icon, any text link leading to Pathfinder, chart marks that mean 'Pathfinder'. Routes between tracks: start, waypoints, finish. Reads 4.5:1 on bg and surface-1.

mod-paths-bg.$description: Tonal card fill for Pathfinder cards and the Pathfinder page header band.

mod-paths-raised.$description: Chips, inner wells and secondary buttons inside a Pathfinder tonal card.

mod-paths-line.$description: Border of a Pathfinder tonal card and dividers inside it.

mod-paths-ink.$description: Titles and primary text inside a Pathfinder tonal card (on mod-paths-bg and mod-paths-raised).

mod-paths-muted.$description: Secondary text inside a Pathfinder tonal card.

on-mod-paths.$description: Text on a solid Pathfinder fill (a Pathfinder action button inside its own page, the module chip in the drawer).

mod-harmony.$description: Key & mood identity: its menu icon, any text link leading to Key & mood, chart marks that mean 'Key & mood'. Camelot keys, mood and energy analysis. Reads 4.5:1 on bg and surface-1.

mod-harmony-bg.$description: Tonal card fill for Key & mood cards and the Key & mood page header band.

mod-harmony-raised.$description: Chips, inner wells and secondary buttons inside a Key & mood tonal card.

mod-harmony-line.$description: Border of a Key & mood tonal card and dividers inside it.

mod-harmony-ink.$description: Titles and primary text inside a Key & mood tonal card (on mod-harmony-bg and mod-harmony-raised).

mod-harmony-muted.$description: Secondary text inside a Key & mood tonal card.

on-mod-harmony.$description: Text on a solid Key & mood fill (a Key & mood action button inside its own page, the module chip in the drawer).

mod-sources.$description: Sources identity: its menu icon, any text link leading to Sources, chart marks that mean 'Sources'. Where tracks come from: tracklists, radio, target tracks, imports. Reads 4.5:1 on bg and surface-1.

mod-sources-bg.$description: Tonal card fill for Sources cards and the Sources page header band.

mod-sources-raised.$description: Chips, inner wells and secondary buttons inside a Sources tonal card.

mod-sources-line.$description: Border of a Sources tonal card and dividers inside it.

mod-sources-ink.$description: Titles and primary text inside a Sources tonal card (on mod-sources-bg and mod-sources-raised).

mod-sources-muted.$description: Secondary text inside a Sources tonal card.

on-mod-sources.$description: Text on a solid Sources fill (a Sources action button inside its own page, the module chip in the drawer).

mod-pipeline.$description: Pipeline identity: its menu icon, any text link leading to Pipeline, chart marks that mean 'Pipeline'. Scrapers, jobs, enrichment, health and data quality. Reads 4.5:1 on bg and surface-1.

mod-pipeline-bg.$description: Tonal card fill for Pipeline cards and the Pipeline page header band.

mod-pipeline-raised.$description: Chips, inner wells and secondary buttons inside a Pipeline tonal card.

mod-pipeline-line.$description: Border of a Pipeline tonal card and dividers inside it.

mod-pipeline-ink.$description: Titles and primary text inside a Pipeline tonal card (on mod-pipeline-bg and mod-pipeline-raised).

mod-pipeline-muted.$description: Secondary text inside a Pipeline tonal card.

on-mod-pipeline.$description: Text on a solid Pipeline fill (a Pipeline action button inside its own page, the module chip in the drawer).

mod-services.$description: Services identity: its menu icon, any text link leading to Services, chart marks that mean 'Services'. Connected services and settings: Spotify, TIDAL, API keys. Reads 4.5:1 on bg and surface-1.

mod-services-bg.$description: Tonal card fill for Services cards and the Services page header band.

mod-services-raised.$description: Chips, inner wells and secondary buttons inside a Services tonal card.

mod-services-line.$description: Border of a Services tonal card and dividers inside it.

mod-services-ink.$description: Titles and primary text inside a Services tonal card (on mod-services-bg and mod-services-raised).

mod-services-muted.$description: Secondary text inside a Services tonal card.

on-mod-services.$description: Text on a solid Services fill (a Services action button inside its own page, the module chip in the drawer).

status-ok.$description: Healthy / passed / perfect transition. Always with the ● glyph or the word. Text/icon colour, 4.5:1 on bg, surface-1 and its own -bg.

status-ok-bg.$description: Tinted fill behind a ok banner, pill or cell.

status-fair.$description: Acceptable but not ideal: compatible transition, degraded-but-working. With the ◐ glyph. Text/icon colour, 4.5:1 on bg, surface-1 and its own -bg.

status-fair-bg.$description: Tinted fill behind a fair banner, pill or cell.

status-warn.$description: Needs a look: stale data, retrying, needs a check. With the ▲ glyph (compat-possible uses ○). Text/icon colour, 4.5:1 on bg, surface-1 and its own -bg.

status-warn-bg.$description: Tinted fill behind a warn banner, pill or cell.

status-bad.$description: Failed / clash / error. With the ✕ glyph. Traffic light in every theme, so the glyph and word are what make it readable without colour. Text/icon colour, 4.5:1 on bg, surface-1 and its own -bg.

status-bad-bg.$description: Tinted fill behind a bad banner, pill or cell.

status-info.$description: Neutral information. Deliberately grey: blue belongs to the Graph module. Text/icon colour, 4.5:1 on bg, surface-1 and its own -bg.

status-info-bg.$description: Tinted fill behind a info banner, pill or cell.

on-status-bad.$description: Text on a solid bad fill: the destructive button.

compat-perfect.$description: Transition / harmonic compatibility: perfect (same key, relative major/minor). Glyph ●.

compat-compatible.$description: Compatible (±1 on the Camelot wheel). Glyph ◐.

compat-possible.$description: Possible with care (+2 energy boost, +7 lift, BPM gap 5–8). Glyph ○.

compat-clash.$description: Clash (any other key move, BPM gap > 8, energy jump ≥ +2). Glyph ✕.

progress-fill.$description: Completion bars and rings. Completion is not health, so it is neutral; a health judgement colours the label, never the bar.

progress-track.$description: Unfilled part of progress bars and rings.

energy-1.$description: Energy 1 of 10 (Low tier). Fill of the energy bar segments and the set wave bars. A mark, never text: the number is always printed beside it.

energy-2.$description: Energy 2 of 10 (Low tier). Fill of the energy bar segments and the set wave bars. A mark, never text: the number is always printed beside it.

energy-3.$description: Energy 3 of 10 (Low tier). Fill of the energy bar segments and the set wave bars. A mark, never text: the number is always printed beside it.

energy-4.$description: Energy 4 of 10 (Low tier). Fill of the energy bar segments and the set wave bars. A mark, never text: the number is always printed beside it.

energy-5.$description: Energy 5 of 10 (Building tier). Fill of the energy bar segments and the set wave bars. A mark, never text: the number is always printed beside it.

energy-6.$description: Energy 6 of 10 (Building tier). Fill of the energy bar segments and the set wave bars. A mark, never text: the number is always printed beside it.

energy-7.$description: Energy 7 of 10 (Building tier). Fill of the energy bar segments and the set wave bars. A mark, never text: the number is always printed beside it.

energy-8.$description: Energy 8 of 10 (High tier). Fill of the energy bar segments and the set wave bars. A mark, never text: the number is always printed beside it.

energy-9.$description: Energy 9 of 10 (High tier). Fill of the energy bar segments and the set wave bars. A mark, never text: the number is always printed beside it.

energy-10.$description: Energy 10 of 10 (High tier). Fill of the energy bar segments and the set wave bars. A mark, never text: the number is always printed beside it.

key-1a.$description: Camelot 1A (A♭ minor). Key dot and wheel segment. Minor (A) is the darker ring; always printed with its code.

key-1b.$description: Camelot 1B (B major). Key dot and wheel segment. Major (B) is the lighter ring; always printed with its code.

key-2a.$description: Camelot 2A (E♭ minor). Key dot and wheel segment. Minor (A) is the darker ring; always printed with its code.

key-2b.$description: Camelot 2B (F♯ major). Key dot and wheel segment. Major (B) is the lighter ring; always printed with its code.

key-3a.$description: Camelot 3A (B♭ minor). Key dot and wheel segment. Minor (A) is the darker ring; always printed with its code.

key-3b.$description: Camelot 3B (D♭ major). Key dot and wheel segment. Major (B) is the lighter ring; always printed with its code.

key-4a.$description: Camelot 4A (F minor). Key dot and wheel segment. Minor (A) is the darker ring; always printed with its code.

key-4b.$description: Camelot 4B (A♭ major). Key dot and wheel segment. Major (B) is the lighter ring; always printed with its code.

key-5a.$description: Camelot 5A (C minor). Key dot and wheel segment. Minor (A) is the darker ring; always printed with its code.

key-5b.$description: Camelot 5B (E♭ major). Key dot and wheel segment. Major (B) is the lighter ring; always printed with its code.

key-6a.$description: Camelot 6A (G minor). Key dot and wheel segment. Minor (A) is the darker ring; always printed with its code.

key-6b.$description: Camelot 6B (B♭ major). Key dot and wheel segment. Major (B) is the lighter ring; always printed with its code.

key-7a.$description: Camelot 7A (D minor). Key dot and wheel segment. Minor (A) is the darker ring; always printed with its code.

key-7b.$description: Camelot 7B (F major). Key dot and wheel segment. Major (B) is the lighter ring; always printed with its code.

key-8a.$description: Camelot 8A (A minor). Key dot and wheel segment. Minor (A) is the darker ring; always printed with its code.

key-8b.$description: Camelot 8B (C major). Key dot and wheel segment. Major (B) is the lighter ring; always printed with its code.

key-9a.$description: Camelot 9A (E minor). Key dot and wheel segment. Minor (A) is the darker ring; always printed with its code.

key-9b.$description: Camelot 9B (G major). Key dot and wheel segment. Major (B) is the lighter ring; always printed with its code.

key-10a.$description: Camelot 10A (B minor). Key dot and wheel segment. Minor (A) is the darker ring; always printed with its code.

key-10b.$description: Camelot 10B (D major). Key dot and wheel segment. Major (B) is the lighter ring; always printed with its code.

key-11a.$description: Camelot 11A (F♯ minor). Key dot and wheel segment. Minor (A) is the darker ring; always printed with its code.

key-11b.$description: Camelot 11B (A major). Key dot and wheel segment. Major (B) is the lighter ring; always printed with its code.

key-12a.$description: Camelot 12A (D♭ minor). Key dot and wheel segment. Minor (A) is the darker ring; always printed with its code.

key-12b.$description: Camelot 12B (E major). Key dot and wheel segment. Major (B) is the lighter ring; always printed with its code.

chart-1.$description: Categorical chart series 1. Use in order; more than 8 categories group the tail as 'Other' in chart-8.

chart-2.$description: Categorical chart series 2. Use in order; more than 8 categories group the tail as 'Other' in chart-8.

chart-3.$description: Categorical chart series 3. Use in order; more than 8 categories group the tail as 'Other' in chart-8.

chart-4.$description: Categorical chart series 4. Use in order; more than 8 categories group the tail as 'Other' in chart-8.

chart-5.$description: Categorical chart series 5. Use in order; more than 8 categories group the tail as 'Other' in chart-8.

chart-6.$description: Categorical chart series 6. Use in order; more than 8 categories group the tail as 'Other' in chart-8.

chart-7.$description: Categorical chart series 7. Use in order; more than 8 categories group the tail as 'Other' in chart-8.

chart-8.$description: Categorical chart series 8. Use in order; more than 8 categories group the tail as 'Other' in chart-8.

chart-grid.$description: Chart gridlines and the tier band behind the energy wave.

chart-ref.$description: Reference and target lines (target wave, average, threshold): 1.5px dashed 5 4.

on-now.$description: Text on a solid now fill (the small "Now" tag).

now.$description: The marker for 'now' (choice "now-marker: c"): the playing track, the current slot, today's column, the current time on a timeline. Amber, so it never reads as 'selected' (brand lavender). A mark (3:1), not body text.

sim.$description: Simulated or hypothetical data (a proposed set, a preview of a rebuild): hatched with this colour and labelled 'Preview'.

svc-spotify.$description: Spotify's own green: only on the 'Connect Spotify' button and Spotify source badge, per Spotify's brand rules.

svc-tidal.$description: TIDAL's black: only on the 'Connect TIDAL' button (with a 1px white border on dark grounds).

space-0.5.$description: Hairline nudges: energy segment gap, icon-to-badge.

space-1.$description: Tight: chip padding block, icon-to-label in dense rows.

space-2.$description: Default gap inside controls and between chips.

space-3.$description: Gap between form fields in a row; table cell inline padding.

space-4.$description: Card padding (compact), page side gutter minimum, gap between cards.

space-6.$description: Gap between sections inside a page; drawer padding.

space-8.$description: Gap between page regions (rail and content).

space-12.$description: Page top padding below the header on wide screens.

radius-chip.$description: Chips, tags, pills with text, energy segments (2px inside bars), key badges.

radius-control.$description: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented controls, menu items, tooltips, table containers.

radius-card.$description: Cards (tonal and neutral), launcher tiles, figure tiles, popovers.

radius-sheet.$description: Drawers' inner edge, dialogs, media viewer: the biggest objects.

radius-pill.$description: Status pills, the toggle switch, progress bars, avatars of services.

control-sm.$description: Small buttons and inputs in dense toolbars and table rows.

control-md.$description: Default button, input and select height.

control-lg.$description: Large buttons: empty-state actions, booth mode, touch-first screens.

touch-min.$description: Minimum hit area for anything tappable on phone and tablet (pad small visuals to reach it).

row-compact.$description: Table row height in compact density.

row-two-line.$description: Two-line rows (title + meta) in lists and the running order.

content-max.$description: Max content width; wider screens centre it.

prose-max.$description: Max line length for running text and help.

z-sticky.$description: Sticky table headers, sticky filter rail.

z-popover.$description: Menus, popovers, context menu, select lists.

duration-instant.$description: Reduced motion: every duration collapses to this.

duration-slow.$description: Chart transitions and graph camera moves (max).

ease-standard.$description: Everything that moves in or changes size.

bp-phone.$description: Below: one column, drawer navigation, tables become cards or scroll in their box.

bp-tablet.$description: Tablet: rails collapse to a Filters button; two-column cards.

bp-desktop.$description: Desktop: filter rail + content; side panels open beside, not over.

bp-wall.$description: Wall/kiosk: booth theme recommended, type scale steps up one size.

opacity-faded.$description: Graph nodes and edges outside the current selection or filter.

opacity-edge.$description: Graph edges drawn without a strength band: legend line samples and the layer toggles. Graph links on the canvas use graph-edge-op-1…4.

shadow-1.$description: Resting cards (Ghost style): barely there; the border does the work.

shadow-2.$description: Popovers, menus, tooltips, the sticky header once scrolled.

shadow-3.$description: Drawers and dialogs above the scrim.
